objective: maximize stable gross directional hit rate at roughly 97-trade-class coverage without using HENGCE/V/X/HR picks, scores, factor weights, or event identities

independence.shared_infrastructure_only: PIT TWSE-listed-electronics raw price/turnover data loader

rule.eligibility: raw r20 > 0 and raw r60 > 0; 20-day turnover >= TWD 20m; valid PIT fields
rule.exit: first subsequent trading-day close strictly above entry open, otherwise forced at 15 trading days

protocol.selection_key: maximize weaker of 2024/2025 hit rates, then 2025, pooled pre-2026, Wilson lower, closeness to 97 trades

comparison_to_97_reference.interpretation: I1 raises historical gross directional hit rate with lower trade coverage; it does not replace the return frontier and its pre-2026 wins are often small.

neighborhood_evidence.note: The top-ranked neighborhood is not a single isolated rule: LOWVOL + R20_POS + H15 produced 86.05% in 2024 and 87.50% in 2025; LOWVOL + R60_POS + H15 produced 86.05% and 86.49%. Several independent families also cluster in the mid-80s, with H15 recurring among top candidates.

concentration_caveat: The 2026 diagnostic remains concentrated: 3045 accounts for 12/26 trades. Removing 3045 reduces the remaining 2026 record to 11/14 = 78.57%, so the 2026 improvement is not yet broad-stock evidence.
data_status_caveat: 2026 was not used to select the rule but has been exposed elsewhere in the broader project; treat it as historical diagnostic evidence, not untouched future OOS.
